notes.title: A huge thanks from me to you!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

A couple of weeks back, the Out Fishing announcement trailer made its debut on IGN. And since then, the game has collected over 15,000 Wishlists on Steam! That is a huge number, one that is beyond what I expected. So to all of you that watched the trailer, commented on the game (both positively and negatively!), left feedback, joined my Discord, and Wishlisted - thank you! You have no idea how motivating that is to a solo dev like me. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627457/a84bf603ccae01882296ede144189881145fc4ae.gif[/img]
[i]The early bird catches the worm...[/i]

Seeing all of the positivity and locomotion around my game gave me a huge boost of confidence in the project. So with that boost, I am off to work! I want to give you updates on how the game is progressing, so you know how Out Fishing is shaping up. If you like, Wishlist and Follow Out Fishing on Steam to get my devlogs and also join my Discord. I’ll be sharing with you my progress and I’ll be keen to hear your thoughts along the way too. After all, I am making this game for you.

Once again, thanks for all your support. This has been one wild week and a bit! 


Stay safe near the lake, 

Mun Mun Games

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3660260/Out_Fishing/

notes.title: Let the fear hook you in! Out Fishing Revealed
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]We’re thrilled (and a little unnerved) to introduce [i]Out Fishing[/i], a first-person horror fishing game that lures players to a remote lake where the forest whispers and the fish aren't the only things watching.[/p][p][/p][p]What starts as a peaceful trip to a quiet, forgotten lake becomes something far stranger. Cast your line, explore a hauntingly beautiful wilderness, and build your camp as the sun sets… but don’t stay out too long. When the light fades, something else wakes up.
[/p][p]Our game was just announced by IGN, and you can watch the reveal trailer right below.[/p][previewyoutube="EfKH7wpy9OU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]We are also part of Steam’s Fishing Fest, so take a look at some great fishing titles that are available to play and Wishlist. [/p][p][/p][p]Out Fishing was inspired by such classics as Alan Wake, Mundaun, and Silent Hill. Explore. Fish. Upgrade your tools and camp. Survive the night. Uncover what really happened here by the lake.
[/p][p]If [i]Out Fishing[/i] caught your eye, add it to your Steam Wishlist. We’ll be sharing new updates, creepy clips, and behind-the-scenes peeks, so come and follow along. [/p][p][/p][p]See you by the lake…[/p][p]— Mūn Mūn[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3660260/Out_Fishing/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Over 400 Wishlists in Less Than 72 Hours — Thank You!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627457/1fc7884849290528cfea100ad8b5bd456f64c569.gif[/img]

Hey everyone,

Just a quick note to say thank you! [b]Out Fishing has already gathered over 400 wishlists in under 72 hours[/b] since its announcement.

As a solo developer, seeing so many of you interested in the game so quickly means the world. Whether you're here from The Daruma Challenge, social media, or just stumbled upon the page — welcome.

This is just the beginning, and I can't wait to show you more.
If you haven’t already, don’t forget to wishlist Out Fishing — it really helps a lot.

Thanks again for being here.
— Mūn Mūn
